coverage.boundaries: Current catalogs and model specs; every actual range minimum/maximum checked by scripts/check_course_inspectors.cjs. All default demo frames also checked with frozen traces, prefix-only steps and throwing result/scene/visual accessors.

scope: Behavior cloning: both fixed expert examples, per-example prediction/error, half-square loss and gradient contributions, empirical averages, one descent update and an explicitly unlabeled held-out prediction.

DAgger: fixed visited observation, learner/expert actions, strict fixed-draw mixing branch, expert labels distinct from executed actions, every aggregated observation/label cell, least-squares numerator and denominator terms.

Actor-Critic/GAE: every fixed sample reward and frozen old value, true-terminal bootstrap boundary, both TD residuals, discounted future residual contribution, both GAE advantages and frozen regression targets.
PPO: supplied single-action probability ratio and frozen advantage, raw product, lower/upper ratio limits, clipped ratio/product, sign-correct min and negated minimization loss.
Maximum entropy: both action probabilities and fixed Q values, per-action exact expectation terms, natural-log entropy terms, entropy bonus and regularized objective.
Model rollout: common initial state and true/model increments, every time-indexed true/model prediction cell, every signed error and one-step/terminal comparisons.

Offline RL support: per-action fixed data count and estimated Q, greedy tie handling, chosen-action coverage, per-action support penalty and adjusted Q, final choice and unchanged absence of unseen-action data.

Goal conditioning: original achieved/desired inputs, original sparse reward/success, relabeled goal and recomputed reward, preserved original evaluation and honest training-entry count including duplicate-goal cases.

checks: All actual demos and all four real frames per demo; unique semantic scalar cells, frozen-trace immutability, no future frame/result/scene/visual reads.
Each experiment changes a real control, verifies concrete before/after outcomes and invariant data, rejects corrupted claimed output and unapplied input changes.
Behavior-cloning gradient independently checked by finite differences of half-square loss.
DAgger strict threshold equality and closed-form fit preserve expert labels regardless of execution branch.
GAE lambda-one targets checked against finite discounted sample returns; lambda-zero and zero-discount terminal cases.
PPO positive/negative/zero advantages with high/low ratio cases verify the conservative min rule.
Natural-log entropy, mirrored distributions, uniform maximum and unchanged policy under temperature changes.
Every rollout prediction and signed negative bias accumulation, plus zero-bias agreement.
Offline adjusted-Q tie choice and support remaining absent despite penalties.
HER relabel success cannot change original-goal failure; identical goals retain two entries without claiming two independent trajectories.

limits: Original finite topic exercises from the current eight-lesson catalog, not complete official CS224R lecture coverage or a claim of policy/model training.
Each model has four actual computation frames; prediction-array time indices are expanded inside their actual generating frame and do not create a synthetic playback timeline.
BC uses two fixed expert samples. DAgger fixes the visited state and expert response, so its mixing control cannot change the training-state distribution in this example.
GAE is one fixed truly terminated sample trajectory, not exact environment expectation. PPO receives a ratio directly and does not invent separate old/new probabilities or update a policy.
Entropy is an exact two-action distribution calculation with fixed Q; it omits continuous SAC, double Q, tanh corrections, learned temperature and target networks.
The model-learning example is a known biased equation rollout; no dynamics are actually estimated and its reference path is computed rather than measured.
Offline support penalties are an explicit teaching contrast, not CQL/IQL implementation or an offline-policy safety evaluation. HER requires rewards that can be recomputed for alternate goals.
Formula text uses four decimal places; numeric cells and experiment verification retain full precision. The shared renderer controls value formatting.
Only this course provider, its test and this manifest were edited; no shared models/configuration/build/UI/browser checks, records, receipts, completion or study minutes were changed.
